releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.3 — the tab bar is clean and the updater is honest. The bottom navigation no longer shows banded, mixed colours behind the active tab: its elevation layer was compositing as an opaque plate under the gradient chip, so the chip is now a flat brand gradient with a white hairline and a spring press, and the labels/icons match the reference sizes. Updates now report real progress — the bar fills with the actual download percentage instead of looping, then switches to 'Installing…'. New in this build: long-press a message for the reference action menu (quick reactions, Reply, Copy, Delete with confirmation), a reply strip above the composer, the Photos/Videos/Files attachment popup, and a full call screen with pulsing rings, live timer and mute/speaker/end controls behind the header call buttons.
